notes: #276 spec-off CUDA baseline: plain graphed serving decode, no drafter anywhere; read the spec-on r2 cells against these to size what speculation itself buys per depth
rationale: The entire published qwen3.8 CUDA win is ours/cuda/spec (133.1/124.9/93.9/69.7) vs llama.cpp/cuda/plain (70.9/68.8/63.4/44.6) -- speculation-mismatched, which standings now refuses to print unlabeled. ours/cuda/plain holds ONE cell, 6.2 at 8192, an eager-arm reading that is not the serving path. This ladder lands the missing bucket on the graphed serving instrument (same CTX-SCALING basis as the spec-on suite, synthetic fp8-KV fill, one depth per process for the #96 residual race). plain-zero-again reruns the identical zero-env arm, so its delta against plain-zero is the measured per-depth null. plain-fix arms NV_Q36_GRAPHED_DECODE_FIX=1 (flash_decode_fused_fp8kv routing) because the serving stack arms it; comparing plain-zero to plain-fix also prices that route on this trunk. Run with --cooldown-below-watts 40 and record power.limit per #278 -- the spec-on r2 rows are 300W cells.
